title: Reliability: controlled faults and graceful degradation
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects reliability: controlled faults and graceful degradation with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. A reliability report shows each injected fault, observed status, trace and invariant outcome.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: Reliability is the ability to deliver an acceptable outcome despite dependency and input failures. AI failures include provider outage, rate limit, timeout, malformed result, hallucinated evidence, stale index, vector-store outage, broken tools, looping agents and context overflow. Not all failures should be retried.
Graceful degradation preserves a smaller truthful capability, such as displaying retrieved evidence without a generated explanation. It must be visible to the user and obey the same permissions.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Define a failure matrix with detection, retryability, fallback, user response and recovery evidence. Use deadlines, bounded retries, circuit breakers, index freshness checks, schema validation and step budgets. Record final status as successful, degraded, rejected or failed.

Inject one failure at a time in deterministic integration tests, then combine realistic correlated failures such as provider rate limits plus queue pressure. Ensure cancelled tasks release resources and duplicate requests cannot duplicate writes.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A fallback invents an explanation when retrieval is unavailable. A timeout handler retries indefinitely because each attempt resets the total deadline. A stale index passes health checks but returns deleted evidence.

Assert visible degraded status, no unsupported claims, bounded attempts and eventual recovery. Simulate both empty evidence and contradictory evidence, because hallucination defenses depend on more than transport errors.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: A reliability report shows each injected fault, observed status, trace and invariant outcome. Error budgets count user-visible failures over a specified window, with separate safety invariants that cannot be averaged away.
SDETs should make fault cases executable release checks, not a list of possible risks. The system passes when it behaves predictably under the failures it claims to tolerate.

mistake: A fallback invents an explanation when retrieval is unavailable. A timeout handler retries indefinitely because each attempt resets the total deadline. A stale index passes health checks but returns deleted evidence.
takeaway: A reliability report shows each injected fault, observed status, trace and invariant outcome.

title: Turn the failure matrix into executable recovery contracts
objectives: Turn the failure matrix into executable recovery contracts
Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects turn the failure matrix into executable recovery contracts with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Acceptance records each fault, expected and observed outcome, trace and recovery evidence.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A failure matrix names each dependency fault, detection signal, allowed recovery and visible result. Provider timeouts, malformed responses, retrieval absence and unsafe tool requests require different handling. Retrying everything treats deterministic invalidity as if it were transient.
Recovery must preserve the original trust boundary and budget. A fallback with broader access or unsupported claims turns a reliability mechanism into a security or quality regression.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Create one fixture per fault and assert final status, attempt limit, retained evidence and effects. The provider adapter uses an outer async deadline; the tool state machine stops repeated signatures; retrieval absence returns explicit abstention.

For combined faults, test shared capacity and cancellation. Recheck permissions and approvals after a resumed task. Keep error categories stable in the public API while retaining safe internal diagnostic references.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A malformed provider response is retried until the deadline but the public response still says success. A fallback copies another tenant's cached answer. A stopped agent's old partial draft is presented as a verified fix.
Inspect actual state and effect counts, not just error wording. Test that resources are released and that the next healthy request can succeed after the fault is removed.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Acceptance records each fault, expected and observed outcome, trace and recovery evidence. A declared tolerance is supported only by an executed case.

SDETs can run this suite without paid model calls by injecting the adapter/tool boundary. Live chaos experiments, when appropriate, add external-dependency evidence but do not replace deterministic recovery tests.

mistake: A malformed provider response is retried until the deadline but the public response still says success. A fallback copies another tenant's cached answer. A stopped agent's old partial draft is presented as a verified fix.
takeaway: Acceptance records each fault, expected and observed outcome, trace and recovery evidence.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: This phase checkpoint connects turn the failure matrix into executable recovery contracts to the shared CI quality platform. Begin with the input contract, identify the expected output, and state which facts are known from fixtures versus inferred. Your task is to produce a reviewable decision, not merely repeat the definition.

Read the phase's worked examples before attempting the assessment. An accepted result must preserve authorized evidence, handle the demonstrated failure mode and explain what would invalidate the decision. Keep a field note containing the fixture ID and your reasoning.

Apply this mechanism to a synthetic incident in the shared fixture set. Preserve input/output identities so a reviewer can reproduce the result. Use the earlier lessons' implementation checks rather than assuming the checkpoint example is correct.

Construct a counterexample that fails the intended invariant, then describe how the same test would catch a future regression. State which layer owns the correction: data, numerical code, API validation, retrieval, policy or evaluation.

quiz.question: A candidate for turn the failure matrix into executable recovery contracts meets the happy path but fails the phase's documented counterexample. What is the defensible decision?
options: Hold release, preserve the failing case and fix the responsible boundary
Release because the happy path passed
Delete the failing case to improve the score
quiz.explanation: The failing counterexample disproves the claimed contract. Retain it as regression evidence and rerun the corrected boundary.
